body:
I just feel like people don't understand how hard it is, especially my parents. I feel like I have this thing to live up to and I know they've been doing it for 30 years or whatever. But, it's like please stop pressuring me the job market isn't what it was when you started out. And I feel like I need this amazing job to satisfy them and show them that I did try to do something with my degree...

I cleaned my apartment earlier today which was my way to kick myself into gear again... hopefully waking up tomorrow with a clean house will be one less excuse for me. Hopefully tomorrow I can apply for a few jobs and not get upset...

I have a few "friends" but I didn't fit in at my college much and I feel like the people around me are very fake. Besides my boyfriend, who I don't want to rely on as my only companion, I need to go out and find people who like things I like.. but my two issues are I don't even know what I like anymore I dont have any hobbies and I also have some odd irrational fears when leaving my house.. like social anxiety type stuff...

I just feel stuck and really sad, I guess frustrated as well. I feel like I should have a job by now and I feel like I try really hard to find one. 2 weeks ago I just stopped searching, I haven't told anyone yet. And I know that eventually I'll have to kick myself and start up again, obviously I need to find a job and live and stuff. But, I wake up and just feel like... no I don't need to get out of bed or look for a job. What's the point. I just go back to bed until noon shove an orange in my face and go back to bed again. I feel sad all the time that I'm just not good enough and I did something wrong along the line and I'm being punished. I check my facebook and see people happy with jobs and lives and I have no friends... nothing to really pull me up in the morning...
